name: mcsr-vid
description: Turns an MCSR Ranked match into a ready-to-edit Kdenlive project: dual-POV VOD download, audio sync, stat overlay, and timeline assembly.

scripts.remotion:studio: npm run build-overlay-css && remotion studio remotion/index.ts
scripts.remotion:render: npm run build-overlay-css && remotion render remotion/index.ts MatchOverlay
scripts.//still: Render one frame of a composition to PNG — the fast visual check before a full render.
scripts.still: npm run build-overlay-css && remotion still remotion/index.ts
scripts.//validate-project: Load a generated .kdenlive through the MLT engine; exit 0 = parses, 1 = malformed XML.
scripts.//export:nvenc: GPU-encode the timeline to out/export.mp4 (h264_nvenc); append out=48 for a short range.
scripts.export:nvenc: melt-7 -consumer avformat:out/export.mp4 vcodec=h264_nvenc preset=p5 cq=23 acodec=aac ab=192k
scripts.//analytics: YouTube Analytics for a published video, via the claude-youtube skill outside this repo.
scripts.//archive: Copy a finished match to the NAS. Copies, never moves - nothing is deleted.
scripts.test: for f in src/*.test.ts remotion/*.test.ts; do echo "-- $f --"; tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
